/* PdaTicPaliMapper.selectBmsInRelatedTicBmsOut : 이고반출관련 반입조회 */ SELECT I.IN_PLAN_NO , I.IN_NO , I.OD_JOB_NO , I.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , I.BL_NO , I.CT , I.WT , P.PACKING_NO , P.PACKING_CNT , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(ISNULL(C.INSPECTION_TYPE,''), 0, 2) = 'S' THEN '선별 ' + ISNULL((SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE CODE = SUBSTRING(ISNULL(C.INSPECTION_TYPE,''), 2, 4) AND ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND GROUP_CODE='SE_INSPECTION_CODE' AND USE_YN='Y'), '') WHEN SUBSTRING(ISNULL(C.INSPECTION_TYPE,''), 0, 2) = 'X' THEN 'XR ' + ISNULL((SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE CODE = SUBSTRING(ISNULL(C.INSPECTION_TYPE,''), 2, 4) AND ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND GROUP_CODE='SE_INSPECTION_CODE' AND USE_YN='Y' AND UPPER(CODE) NOT IN ('C')), '') WHEN SUBSTRING(ISNULL(C.INSPECTION_TYPE,''), 0, 2) = 'P' THEN '통관 ' + ISNULL((SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE CODE = SUBSTRING(ISNULL(C.INSPECTION_TYPE,''), 2, 4) AND ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND GROUP_CODE='SE_INSPECTION_CODE' AND USE_YN='Y'), '') WHEN SUBSTRING(ISNULL(C.INSPECTION_TYPE,''), 0, 2) = 'I' THEN '검역 ' + ISNULL((SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE CODE = SUBSTRING(ISNULL(C.INSPECTION_TYPE,''), 2, 4) AND ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND GROUP_CODE='INSPECTION_TYPE' AND USE_YN='Y'), '') WHEN ISNULL(C.INSPECTION_TYPE,'') = 'B' THEN '거대'
WHEN ISNULL(C.INSPECTION_TYPE,'') = 'T' THEN '지재권' WHEN ISNULL(C.INSPECTION_TYPE,'') = 'A' THEN '집중' END AS BMS_INSPECTION_TYPE , C.INSPECTION_TYPE AS INSPECTION_RESULT_TYPE , O.OUT_CT AS BMS_OUT_CT , O.OUT_NO FROM TB_BMS_IN I WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(IN_PLAN_NO) AS IN_PLAN_NO , MAX(PACKING_NO) AS PACKING_NO , COUNT(*) AS PACKING_CNT FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE MOVE_OUT_CT = 1 AND MOVE_IN_CT = 0 GROUP BY IN_PLAN_NO ) P ON I.IN_PLAN_NO = P.IN_PLAN_NO INNER JOIN ( SELECT IN_NO , OUT_NO , OUT_CT FROM TB_BMS_OUT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE OUT_NO IN ( SELECT MAX(OUT_NO) AS OUT_NO FROM TB_BMS_OUT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE TIC_OUT_SCAN_YN = 'Y' /* 출고픽킹 */ AND OUT_CLASS = '61' AND OUT_APPROVAL_NO = '04002001' GROUP BY IN_NO ) ) O ON O.IN_NO = I.IN_NO INNER JOIN TB_BMS_INSPECT_RESULT C ON I.IN_NO = C.IN_NO AND C.INSPECTION_FINISH_YN = 'N' AND C.INSPECTION_TYPE IN ( 'S01', 'S02', 'X01', 'X02', 'P01', 'P02' ,'B','A','T','C' ) ORDER BY I.IN_NO

/* PdaTicPaliMapper.countWaitPkgFromTicMoveScanLog : 하차대기(C)인 박스스캔 데이터 갯수 조회*/ SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TB_BMS_TIC_MOVE_SCAN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE SCAN_DATE = CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),GETDATE(),120) AND SCAN_RESULT = '완료' AND OUT_BACK_STATUS = 'C' AND IN_NO = #{inNo}
/* PdaTicPaliMapper.selectCompletedOutScanCountByPackingNo : 완료된 반출스캔 존재여부 조회 */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_BMS_OUT_SCAN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE SCAN_NO = #{srchPackingNo} AND SCAN_RESULT = '완료'

/* PdaTicPaliMapper.updateBmsInPlanPkgMoveOutCt : 박스스캔 이고반출수량 update */ UPDATE PP SET PP.MOVE_OUT_CT = 1 FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG PP JOIN TB_BMS_IN_PLAN P WITH (NOLOCK) ON PP.IN_PLAN_NO = P.IN_PLAN_NO WHERE 1=1
AND PP.IN_PLAN_NO = #{srchInPlanNo}

/* PdaTicPaliMapper.updateInspectResultFinishByInspectionResultType : 검사결과 업데이트 */ UPDATE TB_BMS_INSPECT_RESULT SET INSPECTION_START_USER_ID = #{updateUserId}, INSPECTION_START_DATE_TIME = GETDATE(), INSPECTION_FINISH_YN = #{inspectionFinishYn}, INSPECTION_FINISH_REMARKS = #{remarks}, INSPECTION_FINISH_USER_ID = #{updateUserId}, INSPECTION_FINISH_DATE_TIME = GETDATE() WHERE IN_NO = #{inNo} AND INSPECTION_TYPE = #{inspectionResultType}

/* PdaTicPaliMapper.updateAllTicInspectResultFinish : 검사결과 업데이트 */ UPDATE TB_BMS_INSPECT_RESULT SET INSPECTION_START_USER_ID = #{updateUserId}, INSPECTION_START_DATE_TIME = GETDATE(), INSPECTION_FINISH_YN = #{inspectionFinishYn}, INSPECTION_FINISH_REMARKS = #{remarks}, INSPECTION_FINISH_USER_ID = #{updateUserId}, INSPECTION_FINISH_DATE_TIME = GETDATE() WHERE IN_NO = #{inNo} AND INSPECTION_TYPE IN ( 'S01', 'S02', 'X01', 'X02', 'P01', 'P02' ,'B','A','T','C' )
mapper.select: /* BmsTicPaliMapper.selectBmsTicMoveScanCount : 이고반출대상조회 : 이고 반출 대상 Scan Count 조회 */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT PP.PACKING_NO FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG PP WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN TB_BMS_IN_PLAN P WITH (NOLOCK) ON PP.IN_PLAN_NO = P.IN_PLAN_NO WHERE PP.DELETE_YN = 'N' AND P.BL_NO = #{BL_NO} ) P INNER JOIN ( SELECT SCAN_NO FROM TB_BMS_TIC_MOVE_SCAN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE SCAN_DATE = CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),GETDATE(),120) AND SCAN_RESULT = '완료' AND OUT_BACK_STATUS = 'O' AND BL_NO = #{BL_NO} GROUP BY SCAN_NO ) SCAN ON P.PACKING_NO = SCAN.SCAN_NO
mapper.update: /* BmsTicPaliMapper.updateTicMoveScan : 이고반출대상조회 : 이고 반출 대상 Scan Data Update */ UPDATE TB_BMS_TIC_MOVE_SCAN SET OUT_BACK_STATUS = 'P' WHERE BL_NO = #{blNo} AND SCAN_DATE = CONVERT(CHAR(10), GETDATE(), 23) AND OUT_BACK_STATUS = 'O'

/* BmsTicPaliMapper.updateBmsOutTicOutScan : 이고반출대상조회 : 반출 Scan Info Update */ UPDATE TB_BMS_OUT SET TIC_OUT_SCAN_YN = 'Y', CARRYOUT_DATE = CONVERT(CHAR(10), GETDATE(), 23), CARRYOUT_TIME = CONVERT(CHAR(8), GETDATE(), 8) WHERE BL_NO = #{BL_NO}
